Container.Name: tunnelsmith
Container.Overview: Per-destination egress router for HTTP and SOCKS5. Picks the best upstream per host based on observed success, with cooldowns, time decay, cascade-failure handling, and recovery probing. Pair with any of: a Mullvad gluetun container (auto-discovered SOCKS5 mesh), one or more upstream HTTP / SOCKS5 proxies, or the host's direct route. The web UI exposes the live scoreboard and four action buttons (forget, force, force-clear, reset).
Container.Description:
Tunnelsmith sits in front of your apps as an HTTP CONNECT and SOCKS5 proxy. It maintains a per-(host, upstream) scoreboard so each destination eventually settles on the upstream that works for it: 429s and geo-blocks pick a different exit, refused connections and timeouts cool the bad upstream down, and recovered upstreams probe back into rotation automatically.
The web UI on port 9091 is unauthenticated by design: the security boundary is the Docker bridge or the host network, not the port. Keep the UI bound to a private interface or to the bridge network only.
Configuration lives in /etc/tunnelsmith/config.toml inside the container; mount /mnt/user/appdata/tunnelsmith to it. An example config ships at /etc/tunnelsmith/config.toml.example. SIGHUP triggers a hot-reload.

Config.Name: HTTP CONNECT Port
Config.Description: Port the HTTP CONNECT proxy listens on. Point your apps at http://<unraid-ip>:<this-port>.

Config.Name: SOCKS5 Port
Config.Description: Port the SOCKS5 proxy listens on. Useful for clients that prefer SOCKS5 (curl --socks5-hostname, browsers, etc.).

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port the read-and-act web UI listens on. Unauthenticated; restrict via the Docker bridge or your network.

Config.Name: Config Directory
Config.Description: Directory holding config.toml. The container reads /etc/tunnelsmith/config.toml at startup; copy /etc/tunnelsmith/config.toml.example out, edit, save as config.toml, then restart or send SIGHUP.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: One of debug, info, warn, error. JSON structured logging.
